title: Implement page Orders
context: A shopper had no way to look at past orders in the shop. The header now has a link to a new orders page. The page lists every order with its date, its status and its total. Four buttons above the list show all orders, or only the open, the shipped or the cancelled ones.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens any page, **then** [the header shows an "Orders" link to `/orders`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13).
- **When** a shopper opens `/orders`, **then** [the page shows "Loading your orders…"](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9) until the request for `/api/orders` answers.
- **When** the request answers with orders, **then** [the page shows one row per order, with its date, its status and its total](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L18-22).
- **When** the request answers with no orders, **then** [the page shows "No orders to show."](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-16) under the four buttons.
- **When** the request fails, **then** [the page shows "Your orders could not be loaded."](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10) and no buttons.
- **When** a shopper clicks "shipped", **then** [the app requests `/api/orders?status=shipped`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5).
- **When** the page shows the shipped orders, **then** [the "shipped" button is disabled](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L16).
- **When** a shopper clicks a status that was not requested before, **then** ["Loading your orders…" replaces the buttons and the list](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9) until the request answers.
- **When** a shopper leaves `/orders` and comes back without a reload, **then** [the status chosen before is still chosen](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore).
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue, the cart or the account page, **then** nothing changes below the header.
## Implementation
**`src/api/orders.ts`**

- Added [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders), a function that [requests `/orders` for a `status` of `null` and `/orders?status=open` for a `status` of `"open"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5).
**`src/hooks/use-orders.ts`**

- Added [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders), a hook that [calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", status]` and `fetchOrders(status)` as the query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L6).
**`src/router.tsx`**
- Added [the import of `OrdersPage`](code:src/router.tsx#L5).
- Modified [`router`](code:src/router.tsx#router) to [render `<OrdersPage />` at the path `orders`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), a child of the `/` route.
**`src/routes/orders/components/`**

- Added [`<OrderRow />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#OrderRow), a component that renders one `<li>` with [the date of `order.placedAt`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L7), [`order.status`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L8) and [the total from `formatPrice(order.totalCents)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L9).
- Added [`STATUSES`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#STATUSES), a constant with `"open"`, `"shipped"` and `"cancelled"`.

- Added [`<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), a component that renders [an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12-14) and [one button per entry of `STATUSES` that calls `setStatus()` with that entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19).
**`src/routes/orders/index.tsx`**

- Added [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage), a component that [reads the chosen status from the store](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), [calls `useOrders(status)`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L8) and renders [a loading message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9), [an error message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10), [an empty message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-16) or [one `<OrderRow />` per order](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L18-22).
**`src/routes/root-layout.tsx`**
- Modified [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#RootLayout) to [render `<Link to="/orders">Orders</Link>`](code:src/routes/root-layout.tsx#L13) after the "Account" link.
**`src/stores/order-filter-store.ts`**
- Added [`OrderFilterState`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L4-7), an interface with `status` and `setStatus`.

- Added [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore), a Zustand store that [starts with `status: null`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L10) and whose [`setStatus()` calls `set({ status })`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L11-13).
- Added [`selectStatus()`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#selectStatus), a function that [returns `state.status`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L17).
**`src/types/order.ts`**
- Added [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), a type that is `"open"`, `"shipped"` or `"cancelled"`.
- Added [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order), an interface with `id`, `placedAt`, `status` and `totalCents`.

files.title: The API module requests orders by status
summary: Added [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders), a function that [requests `/orders` for a `status` of `null` and `/orders?status=open` for a `status` of `"open"`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5).

[`fetchOrders()` calls `request<Order[]>()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L5) and [takes an `OrderStatus | null`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4). This pull request declares [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus) and [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order).

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrders()` to request the orders of a status
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrders()` that requests `/orders` for a `status` of `null` and `/orders?status=shipped` for `"shipped"`, and returns a `Promise<Order[]>`. [`useOrders()` calls it as the query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L6), so that [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage) lists the orders of the status a shopper chose. `request()` in `src/api/client.ts` throws an `ApiError` when the response is not ok, and the page then [returns its error message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10).

files.title: A query hook caches orders per status
summary: Added [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders), a hook that [calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", status]` and `fetchOrders(status)` as the query function](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L6).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of `useQuery`, `fetchOrders` and `OrderStatus`
waypoints.reading: The author added three imports that name `useQuery` from `@tanstack/react-query`, [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) from `@/api/orders` and the type [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus) from `@/types/order`. [`useOrders()` uses all three](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders).

waypoints.title: Added `useOrders()` to query the orders per status
waypoints.reading: The author added a hook `useOrders()` that calls `useQuery` with the key `["orders", status]` and a query function that calls [`fetchOrders(status)`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders). The status is part of the key, so that [a new `status` in `<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7-8) reads another cache entry, and starts a request when that entry has no data. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `staleTime` to 30 000 ms and `retry` to `false`, so one failed request sets `isError` to `true`.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is where a chosen status becomes a request: the status is part of the query key, so each status is requested and cached on its own. [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage) shows what this hook returns for the chosen status.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrderRow />` to render one order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderRow />` that renders one `<li>` with three `<span>` elements:

- the date of `order.placedAt`, from `toLocaleDateString()` in the locale of the browser
- `order.status`, the value `"open"`, `"shipped"` or `"cancelled"` as the API sends it
- `formatPrice(order.totalCents)`, a price in US dollars: `formatPrice()` in `src/lib/format.ts` divides the cents by 100

[`<OrdersPage />` renders one per order](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L19-21) with `order.id` as the key, so that a shopper reads each order on a row of its own.

files.title: Four buttons set the chosen status
summary: Added [`<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), a component that renders [an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12-14) and [one button per entry of `STATUSES` that calls `setStatus()` with that entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19).

[`<OrderStatusFilter />` renders the buttons and reads the store](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter), and [`STATUSES` is an `OrderStatus[]`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L5).

waypoints.title: Added `STATUSES`, the statuses the filter offers
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `STATUSES` that lists `"open"`, `"shipped"` and `"cancelled"`. [`<OrderStatusFilter />` renders one button per entry](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L15-19), so that the order of the array is the order of the buttons after "All". The type `OrderStatus[]` gives a compile error for a string outside [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), and none for a member the array leaves out.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrderStatusFilter />` to choose a status
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderStatusFilter />` that:

- reads `status` with `useOrderFilterStore(selectStatus)`, and `setStatus` from the same store
- renders an "All" button that calls `setStatus(null)`
- renders one button per entry of [`STATUSES`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#STATUSES), and each calls `setStatus()` with its own status, such as `setStatus("shipped")`
- sets `disabled` on the button whose status equals `status`

[`setStatus()` writes the status to the store](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L11-13) and [`<OrdersPage />` reads it from there](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), so that a click changes the list with no prop between the two components. `<Button>` from `@/components/ui` passes `onClick` and `disabled` to a `<button>`.

files.title: The orders page lists the chosen status
summary: Added [`<OrdersPage />`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage), a component that [reads the chosen status from the store](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), [calls `useOrders(status)`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L8) and renders [a loading message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L9), [an error message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L10), [an empty message](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L15-16) or [one `<OrderRow />` per order](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L18-22).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of the hook, the store and the two components
waypoints.reading: The author added four imports that name [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) from `@/hooks/use-orders`, [`selectStatus()`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#selectStatus) and [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore) from `@/stores/order-filter-store`, [`<OrderRow />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#OrderRow) and [`<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter). [`<OrdersPage />` uses all five](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#OrdersPage), and this pull request declares each of them.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrdersPage />` to list the orders of a status
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `` that: - reads `status` with `useOrderFilterStore(selectStatus)` and passes it to [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) - returns `

Loading your orders…

` while `isPending` is `true` - returns `

Your orders could not be loaded.

` when `isError` is `true` - renders the heading "Your orders" and [``](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#OrderStatusFilter) - renders `

No orders to show.

` for an empty array, or one [``](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#OrderRow) per order [`router` renders it at `/orders`](code:src/router.tsx#L16), so that a shopper has a page for past orders. The two early returns come before ``: a status with no cached orders replaces the buttons and the list with the loading message.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the page the pull request exists for: it passes the chosen status of [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore) to [`useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#useOrders) and decides which of four outputs a shopper sees. The other waypoints declare what it reads and renders.

files.title: The header links to the orders page

waypoints.title: Added the "Orders" link to the header
waypoints.reading: The author added a link to the component `<RootLayout />` that renders `<Link to="/orders">Orders</Link>` in the header, after the "Account" link. [`router` renders `<RootLayout />` around every route](code:src/router.tsx#L10-11), so that a shopper reaches [the `orders` route](code:src/router.tsx#L16) from every page.

files.title: A store holds the chosen status
summary: Added [`useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#useOrderFilterStore), a Zustand store that [starts with `status: null`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L10) and whose [`setStatus()` calls `set({ status })`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L11-13).

waypoints.title: Added the imports of `create` and `OrderStatus`
waypoints.reading: The author added two imports that name `create` from `zustand` and the type [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus) from `@/types/order`. [`useOrderFilterStore` is the result of `create<OrderFilterState>()`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L9), and [`status` is an `OrderStatus | null`](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L5).

waypoints.title: Added `OrderFilterState`, the shape of the filter store
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `OrderFilterState` that has `status`, an `OrderStatus | null`, and `setStatus`, a function that takes an `OrderStatus | null` and returns nothing. [`useOrderFilterStore` is created with it](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L9) and [`selectStatus()` takes it as its argument](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L16), so that `null` is the one value for all orders in the store, in [the hook](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L5) and in [the request](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4-5). The interface is not exported.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrderFilterStore` to hold the chosen status
waypoints.reading: The author added a Zustand store `useOrderFilterStore` that starts with `status: null` and whose `setStatus()` calls `set({ status })`. [`<OrderStatusFilter />` calls `setStatus()` on a click](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L12-16) and [`<OrdersPage />` reads `status`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), so that the buttons and the list share one value. The store is a module-level value and nothing sets `status` back to `null`, so the chosen status is still there when a shopper comes back to `/orders` without a reload.

waypoints.title: Added `selectStatus()` to the filter store
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `selectStatus()` that takes an `OrderFilterState` and returns its `status`. [`<OrdersPage />` passes it to `useOrderFilterStore`](code:src/routes/orders/index.tsx#L7), and [so does `<OrderStatusFilter />`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L8), so that both components read the chosen status through one function and render again when it changes.

files.title: The types of an order and its status
summary: Added [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus), a type that is `"open"`, `"shipped"` or `"cancelled"`.

waypoints.title: Added the type `OrderStatus`
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `OrderStatus` that is `"open"`, `"shipped"` or `"cancelled"`. It is the type of [`Order.status`](code:src/types/order.ts#L6), of [the argument of `fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4), of [the argument of `useOrders()`](code:src/hooks/use-orders.ts#L5), of [`status` in the filter store](code:src/stores/order-filter-store.ts#L5) and of [the entries of `STATUSES`](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderStatusFilter.tsx#L5), so that a string outside the three gives a compile error in each.

waypoints.title: Added the interface `Order`
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `Order` that has `id` and `placedAt` as strings, `status` as an [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus) and `totalCents` as a number. [`fetchOrders()` returns a `Promise<Order[]>`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4-5) and [`<OrderRow />` takes one `Order` as its prop](code:src/routes/orders/components/OrderRow.tsx#L4), so that the row reads the fields the request declares. `request()` in `src/api/client.ts` casts the JSON body to the type and does not validate it.
